name: 男女通用防漏保温午餐包款
description: 防漏易洁内里、三层保温结构、可提可背的通勤野餐午餐包

styleLock.direction: rugged leakproof insulated lunch bag ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, warm off-white #F2EDE6 for info and closing panels, one accent orange #EF8A17 for pills, rules and the closing band
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio key from the front-left with a low fill card, single soft contact shadow, skimming side light only on texture macros, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm board #F2EDE6, brushed stone counter #E7E2DC, woven picnic mat #DFCDA8, light oak desk #C9A578
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline plus short pill labels, all wording supplied at generation time
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in accent #EF8A17, only seal, check, cross, snowflake and sun glyphs
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 product angle with the strap coiled at one side, lid closed except on open-interior shots, identical scale and silhouette across the set
noDrift: no invented spec numbers or badge artwork
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium leakproof lunch bag visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F2EDE6, charcoal #2D2D2D and one orange accent #EF8A17; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and one soft contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用方正包型加提手肩带的一眼识别度抢点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn, full body visible, whole product unclipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow under the base
shots.whitespace: even clean margin all around the silhouette, no extra whitespace inside the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bag stands upright, photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 turn so the front panel and one side wall both read; top handle raised, shoulder strap coiled against the left side, full body visible and unclipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and a soft fill card, one soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, with an even clean margin all around and no extra whitespace inside the frame. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no colorway strip along the bottom edge, no readable lettering or wordmark on the front panel, no embossed logo shapes, no props, no hands, no food, no watermark, no gradient background, no floating product without a contact shadow, no cut-off handle or strap.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清同一只包保冷与保温双用的核心利益

shots.lighting: left panel crisp 6500K cool key, right panel soft 3200K warm key, matching contact shadows on both

shots.props: two blank rounded label pills and two thin-line glyphs

Right state: {product} standing closed and dry on a warm off-white board #F2EDE6 beside one neatly folded dry cloth, lit by a bright soft front-left key with a single contact shadow. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Negative: no readable text, no brand wordmark, no exaggerated disaster scene, no invented statistics or percentages, no mould, no insects or contamination, no plastic-looking food, no deformed hands, no duplicated bag.

shots.intent: 用面料织纹与拉链五金的质感特写消除做工疑虑

shots.lighting: skimming side light from the left sweeping across the weave, one controlled highlight on the metal

Neutral matte board background #D9D4CC. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal negative space because the texture is the subject. Negative: no readable lettering or logo glyphs on the hardware, no plastic-looking synthetic sheen, no blurry subject, no duplicated zipper sliders, no heavy noise, no colour cast, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底 3/4 包型主图（提手+可拆肩带+前袋+侧网袋+双拉链头+底部四色小样条）；002 沙滩野餐人物场景带顶部大字标题；003 上半面料分层引线标注、下半保冷与保温双栏各配时长数字；004 透视包体装满易拉罐配三条尺寸线与容量角标；005 注水防漏演示加两枚拱形接缝特写与勾叉双栏；006 大理石台面开盖装水水果加三个圆形细节插图；007 肩垫特写加户外室内双栏人物携带；008 厨房台面备餐场景人物微笑面部清晰；009 办公桌午餐场景背景人物背影。品类判定依据：主体为带提手与可调肩带的软质便携包，整套分镜一半篇幅讲携带方式与配色可选，故按图归箱包/小包，未沿用源平台常见的厨房或户外冷藏挂类；防漏与保温属包袋结构卖点而非电器功能，故不归家用电器。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、皮标上的图形、原图英文标语与栏目字样、时长与容量与尺寸等一切数字主张、人物面孔与身份、瓶身与餐盒上的商标图案、原平台促销角标与社会证明；9 升容量数字与英寸尺寸均未入稿，规格一律改为空白引线框、空标签胶囊、空单元格与空白按钮承载。
